facts.fact: The Niger Digital Day national caravan, launched at its Diffa leg on 3 September 2026 with about 60 participants, trains young people in digital tools and trades and is to tour all eight regions of Niger.

systems.owner: Niger Digital Day founders with Universite de Diffa

facts.fact: Governor of Tahoua launched a free digital training for 140 young people on 25 August 2026 as part of the Niger Digital Day national tour, sponsored by the Minister of Communication and New Information Technologies.
Niger Digital Day's focal point says it trained more than 300 young people in 6 regions in 2025 and will cover all 8 regions this year.

The Niger Digital Day 2026 caravan, launched in Maradi on 18 August 2026 by the region's delegated administrator, is a youth digital-skills programme the organisers say will run in all eight regions and reach over 800 young people.

An Algerie Telecom delegation visited ESCEP in Niamey on 9 September 2026 to study rapid deployment of a digital Skills Center, under a July 2026 partnership accord, to train people in ICT, cybersecurity, AI and robotics.

facts.fact: Le Sahel reports that the national digital and financial literacy campaign for rural populations, part of the World Bank-funded PVI project under the national information society agency ANSI, trained nearly 38,000 people nationwide in phase one against a 65,000 target, with phase two launched at a trainers' workshop in Niamey on 20-24 June 2024.

facts.fact: The PVI coordinator says the project has trained 350,000 beneficiaries, a majority women, in digital skills through its digital literacy and financial education campaign, with digital centres open in the 8 regions.
